camel_example: aliyun iot GetDeviceShadow --region cn-hangzhou --ProductKey a1T27vz0000 --DeviceName device1
description_en: Queries the device shadow information of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的影子信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-device-shadow --product-key a1T27vz0000 --device-name device1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeviceShadow

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的设备所属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The device name of the device to query
parameters.name: device_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

ShadowMessage.description_en:
The device shadow information returned if the call is successful.

The structure of the returned device shadow information varies depending on the status of the device shadow. For more information, see [Device shadow development]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53930.html）
ShadowMessage.description_zh:
调用成功时，返回的设备影子信息。

根据影子设备的不同状态，查询到的影子信息结构有所差别，详情请参见[设备影子开发]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/53930.html）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
